intro.description: We combine field sensors, weather forecasts and tree-by-tree sampling to turn alternate bearing into decisions. From the first chill alert to the end of the season, Viora tells you what to do and how much to expect from your harvest.
intro.aboutBody: A Peruvian platform that manages alternate bearing in olive groves. We measure winter chill, fruit load and thinning with field nodes and offline sampling, so every season depends on data, not on each year's luck.

terms.title: Terms and conditions
terms.notice: Academic draft by ArcadiaDevs (UPC 1ACC0238, 2026-20). Not legal advice. For users in Peru, the Spanish version prevails in case of conflict.

nature.heading: Parties and project nature
nature.body: Viora is a B2B SaaS for olive alternate bearing in Tacna, built by ArcadiaDevs as an academic project. This document governs only the static website. You is the site visitor. We is ArcadiaDevs.

acceptance.heading: Acceptance and contracting mode
acceptance.body: Browsing this site and opening this dialog is informed browsing: no account, no subscription, no app access. The SaaS contract happens only inside the mobile app with express sign-up and a separate App ToS acceptance.

scope.heading: Landing scope
scope.body: Informational only: value proposition, modules (fruit load, winter chill, thinning plan), cases, video, team, and indicative pricing. No forms, no sign-up, no payments, and no personalized agronomic advice on this site.

disclaimer.heading: Agronomic disclaimer
disclaimer.body: BBI Hoblyn index, Erez chill portions, thinning window (20%-50%), and yield projections are decision-support outputs, not phytosanitary diagnoses and not guarantees of tonnes, calibres, or end of alternate bearing. Nothing here is professional agronomic advice.

force.heading: Force majeure and third-party data
force.body: Models depend on SENAMHI / OpenWeather and sensor networks. Outages of those sources, and El Nino / La Nina and other climate events (Civil Code art. 1315), release ArcadiaDevs from liability for crop loss or lost profits. Per Civil Code art. 1328, no exclusion covers willful misconduct or gross negligence.

confidentiality.heading: Commercial confidentiality
confidentiality.body: This site does not ask for your volumes, calibres, or prices. In the app, that data is treated as a trade secret (Andean Decision 486, art. 260) with reasonable safeguards. Cooperative aggregation requires your express consent; we do not sell individual data.

pricing.heading: Pricing, currency, billing
pricing.body: PEN / USD prices shown are indicative and include IGV (18%) where applicable. Clicking download or viewing prices charges nothing. Purchase happens only in the app via Mercado Pago Checkout Pro. ArcadiaDevs issues the electronic receipt per SUNAT rules.

downloads.heading: Downloads, stores, external links
downloads.body: Download buttons open an informational availability dialog; until official URLs ship, they do not navigate away. When they link to Google Play / App Store, those stores have their own terms, outside ArcadiaDevs.

ip.heading: Intellectual property
ip.body: Code, algorithms, marks, logos, and designs belong to ArcadiaDevs. Open-source components (Three.js, GSAP, Lenis) keep their MIT / Apache 2.0 licenses. No license is granted beyond viewing this site.

disputes.heading: Complaints book and disputes
disputes.body: Per D.S. 011-2011-PCM, the footer links the virtual Complaints Book (reply within 15 business days). These Terms are governed by Peruvian law (Law 29733, Law 29571, Civil Code). Venue: courts of Lima or Tacna per applicable consumer rules.

amendments.heading: Amendments and versions
amendments.body: Material changes are notified at least 15 days in advance via prominent site or app notice. Continued use after effectiveness means acceptance. This text is versioned with the repo SemVer tag.

contact.heading: Contact
contact.body: Privacy and ARCO rights: privacidad@viora.pe. Consumer claims: the site Complaints Book.

privacy.title: Privacy policy
privacy.notice: This policy covers the landing page only. App data is governed by a separate App Privacy Policy accepted expressly at sign-up.

tracking.heading: Zero-tracking statement
tracking.body: This static website does not use tracking cookies, advertising pixels, or third-party analytics. We only use your browser local storage (localStorage) to remember language and interface settings. This data never leaves your browser and can be cleared anytime.

storage.heading: What we store in your browser
storage.body: Language preference, visual-effects preference (viora_pref_distortion), and audio preference (viora_pref_sound). Basis: technical necessity and legitimate interest. No profiling, no sharing.

logs.heading: Infrastructure logs
logs.body: The Vercel CDN passively processes technical logs (IP, User-Agent, timestamp) to deliver content and mitigate DDoS, typically retained 30 days. Vercel Inc. acts as processor under Law 29733.

gateway.heading: What this landing does NOT ask
gateway.body: No forms, newsletter, accounts, or payments here: you provide no name, ID, email, phone, plots, harvests, or card data. App sign-up is governed separately with express consent.

arco.heading: ARCO rights and ANPD complaint
arco.body: Exercise Access, Rectification, Erasure, and Objection via privacidad@viora.pe with your ID, the right invoked, and a notification address. Deadlines: Access 20 business days; Rectification, Erasure, and Objection 10 business days each. These rights cannot be waived.

processors.heading: Processors and transfers
processors.body: Vercel (hosting/CDN), Mercado Pago (in-app payments), Twilio (in-app messaging), and Google FCM (in-app push) act as processors. Weather data uses coordinates only, without personal data.

communications.heading: Communications
communications.body: This landing sends no messages. In the app, thinning, frost, or irrigation alerts are contract performance; marketing needs separate opt-in and can be revoked anytime.

security.heading: Security, retention, minors
security.body: Reasonable industry safeguards; in the app: TLS 1.3, on-device SQLCipher, 15-minute rotating JWTs, and per-cooperative RLS. Payments carry a 5-year tax retention (SUNAT). This service is not directed at minors.

changes.heading: Changes, versions, contact
changes.body: Material changes with 15-day prominent notice; version aligned to the SemVer tag. ARCO contact: privacidad@viora.pe. Consumer claims: Complaints Book (15 business days). Governing law: Peru.

features.line1: Viora reads the load of your grove,
features.line2: tracks the chill of every winter
features.line3: and tells you when to thin.
features.line4: Steadier harvests.

modules.lead: This is how Viora supports every stage of your season, from winter to harvest.
modules.loadBody: Sample your trees, even without signal, and know the real load of every lot before the season decides for you.
modules.chillBody: Viora adds up each winter's chill portions for your variety, table or oil, and warns you when a warm winter puts your bloom at risk.
modules.thinningBody: Know how much to thin and until when, for more even calibres and a next season that doesn’t collapse.

off.label: Off year
off.quote: “I don’t know how much I’ll harvest until it’s too late.”
off.pain: A loaded year, then an empty one. The season is planned blind.
off.title: Viora gives you the number before harvest.
off.body: Sample a few trees from your phone, even without signal, and the app works out the target load of the lot and the yield you can expect this season.

chill.label: Low chill
chill.pain: Without enough chill, bloom comes uneven and the fruit set falls short.
chill.title: Viora counts every hour of cold.
chill.body: Weather data adds up the chill portions for your variety, table or oil, and warns you when a warm winter or an El Niño year puts your bloom at risk.

late.label: Late thinning
late.quote: “By the time I wanted to thin, it was already late.”
late.pain: Too much fruit on the tree: small calibres now, a collapse next season.
late.title: Viora opens your thinning window.
late.body: It tells you how much fruit to remove and by when, tree by tree, so calibres even out and next year’s crop holds.

intake.label: Uncertain intake
intake.quote: “I don’t know how much we’ll collect this year.”
intake.pain: Contracts, crews and storage are all set on guesswork.
intake.title: Viora projects your whole intake.
intake.body: It rolls every member’s estimate into one projection, so contracts, crews and storage are planned before the harvest starts.

tacna.statement: Tacna grows 81% of Peru's olives, yet every season is decided blind: one year there's fruit to spare, the next there's not enough.
tacna.copy: In 2024, growers in La Yarada reported losses of up to 90%. In September 2025, a record rebound. They aren't two different stories: they're the two faces of the same ON/OFF cycle.
tacna.statOffLabel: seasons end in an OFF year
tacna.pictureAlt: A young grower looks up, dreaming of a branch heavy with olives
tacna.placeTitle: Between La Yarada and Los Palos
tacna.placeCopy: Sand, sun and wells: this is where most of the country's olives are grown. Viora orders this grove's season — it measures the load, tracks the chill and sets the thinning window — so next year stops depending on chance.

sky.alt: Aerial view of olive groves and irrigation ponds along the road through La Yarada, Tacna

segments.title: Who it's for
segments.panelAlt: A grower and a technical manager check an olive branch together in the grove
segments.growerAlt: Portrait of an olive grower in his hat, with the grove behind him
segments.managerAlt: Portrait of a technical manager with glasses and a clipboard at the collection centre
segments.growersCopy: Know your grove's chill, each tree's load and when to thin, from your phone and even with no signal in the field.
segments.swingTitle: One year too much, the next too little
segments.swingCopy: Selling well one season and barely covering costs the next shouldn't be normal. Viora was born to smooth out that swing.
segments.managersCopy: See the alternate-bearing risk of every member on a map by sector, and forecast the intake before the harvest arrives.
segments.fieldTitle: You can't be at every plot
segments.fieldCopy: Visiting every farm, writing it in a notebook and typing it into Excel costs you weeks. Viora brings the field to your screen, on time.

reasons.title: A bad season costs more than Viora
reasons.copy: Pick the access that fits your grove: one plan for growers and another for cooperatives that bring their advisors along.
reasons.scienceCopy: Winter chill, alternate-bearing index and ENSO risk, calculated with agronomic models built for the olive tree.
reasons.windowCopy: Viora tells you when the thinning window opens and closes, so the right moment never slips by.
reasons.fieldCopy: Record samples tree by tree with no signal and sync when you're back online.
reasons.coopCopy: Your cooperative and its advisor work from the same data you do, without waiting for the next visit.

about.question: Why not the best one?
about.artAlt: Illustration of the five ArcadiaDevs members raising a trophy together
about.idea: The idea behind Viora is simple: no season should be decided blind. We are ArcadiaDevs, five UPC students who turned the Tacna olive grove’s problem into a product. From data to the field.
about.membersCopy: Five profiles, one product. Each member leads a front of Viora, from design to architecture and quality.
about.mission: Viora exists so that alternate bearing stops being a lottery. Our mission is to turn complex agronomic data into simple, timely decisions within reach of any grower. Our vision is that no olive harvest in southern Peru is lost for lack of information or left to the luck of the season.
